source: On Blackwell, matrix multiplication became fast enough that the forward pass can become constrained by softmax/exponential work relative to tensor-core ZXNAME0000XZ. FA4 uses software-emulated exponential and avoids unnecessary rescaling when the running maximum does not require it, reducing pressure on slower non-matmul resources.[7]
zh: 在 Blackwell 上，矩阵乘法变得足够快，以至于前向传播可能会受到相对于张量核心 ZXNAME0000XZ 的 softmax/指数工作的限制。 FA4 使用软件模拟指数，并在运行最大值不需要时避免不必要的重新缩放，从而减轻较慢的非 matmul 资源的压力。 [7]
